docs/guidance/guidelines_v5_2_0_rc6_wiza.new: Cross-year PSU design update (after w5p, October 2026). Step 4 replaces the PSU-consistency checkbox with an explicit choice: same PSUs across years, independently sampled surveys, or not specified. MFH does not run until the first or second is chosen. Independently sampled surveys use year-specific PSUs and strata and zero cross-year sampling covariance, without constraining the MFH random-effect covariance. Earlier checked settings load as linked and earlier unchecked settings as not specified.

docs/guidance/guidelines_v5_2_0_rc6_wiza.old: Review whether PSU codes are consistent and sampling dependence is plausible. Use zero covariance for independent rounds or a documented sensitivity.
docs/guidance/guidelines_v5_2_0_rc6_wiza.new: Choose the cross-year PSU design in Step 4 from the survey documentation, and check that sampling dependence is plausible. Choosing independently sampled surveys sets the sampling covariance to zero. On linked surveys, zero covariance is only a documented sensitivity.

docs/guidance/guidelines_v5_2_0_rc6_wiza.old: The PSU-consistency checkbox records your assessment of whether identifiers refer to the same sampling units across years. In this release, that checkbox alone does not change estimates; choose the sampling-covariance option to reflect the actual survey design.
docs/guidance/guidelines_v5_2_0_rc6_wiza.new: Choose the cross-year PSU design from the survey documentation. Same PSUs across years uses the selected covariance option. Independently sampled surveys use year-specific designs and zero sampling covariance. With Not specified, MFH does not run; to run UFH alone, deselect MFH. Identical code values alone establish neither linkage nor independence.
